verdict.rationale: The evidence shows recurring billing: subscriptions charge customers on a recurring basis, and failed payments are retried automatically. It also mentions 'Billing automations' for customer communications. None of this documents a way to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, and no recurring-schedule configuration for automations is shown. Recurring charges are an adjacent, domain-specific feature, not general workflow scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
